functions.name: renderPetalTooltip
functions.signature: (type $t76) (param $p0 i32) (param $p1 i32) (param $p2 f32) (param $p3 i32) (param $p4 f32) (param $p5 f32)
functions.notes: Renders a petal tooltip into a 1080-byte cache entry: name, rarity label, up to four stat lines, packed RGB rarity colour and seven 152-byte line objects, then hands them to layout helper 691. Cached entries ignore later definition changes. Destroys the layout display object through vtable slot 4/5 and frees the temporary pointer.

validation.comparison: Thirty-two scenarios: rarities 0..6 crossed with stat counts 0/2/4, invalid ids -1/0/39/255, a non-empty display list, zero/NaN/infinite float parameters, three cache hits with changed definitions and a dirty line colour, and an out-of-bounds display-list trap. Each compares outcome/error, complete 67,108,864-byte memory and the stack pointer.
limitations: Glyph layout and rasterisation remain in native 691; no pixels are compared.
Cache overflow beyond seven lines, stat counts above four, display lists above one transform and definition string-pointer OOB are not exercised.
free 362, fillMemory 382 and helpers 691/801 remain native dependencies.
Ledger: 440 client bodies recovered and 3,805 remain machine code.
